properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated May 31, 1935, on stationery from the Manila Hotel; includes brief update on operations in Manila and call with J.T.T. [Juan Trippe]; mentions [William L.] Bond, Dai [Enki], Mr. Bennett.
